questions.question: What is part practice? / [CO6]
questions.solution_html:
• What is part practice? [A] / [CO6]
  • Ans: Part practice is a training method that involves breaking down a complex skill into smaller
  • components and practicing each part separately before combining them to perform the entire skill. This
  • approach is useful for learning complex or unfamiliar movements, as it allows a performer to focus on
  • specific parts without being overwhelmed

questions.question: What are the key principles of Naturalism in physical education? / [CO4, CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• What are the key principles of Naturalism in physical education? [K]/[CO4, CO5]
  • Ans: The key principles of Naturalism in physical education include developing the child according to
  • their innate nature and instincts, believing nature is the ultimate reality and best teacher, and using
  • experiences from the natural world as the primary learni ng environment. This approach emphasizes
  • physical education, health training, and self -preservation, while advocating for a child -centered, non-
  • fixed curriculum that prioritizes playing and learning through doing, with discipline arising from natural
  • consequences. Nature as the ultimate reality and teacher, Child-centered and instinct-driven curriculum,
  • Learning by doing and sensory training, Autonomy and freedom.
